exercises.name: Freedom Shield
exercises.location: Republic of Korea (Camp Humphreys, Pyeongtaek and nationwide)
exercises.summary: Annual springtime ROK-US-UNC combined exercise with live, virtual, constructive and field training to strengthen combined all-domain defense posture.
exercises.coord_basis: Plotted at Camp Humphreys; exercise nationwide

exercises.name: Ulchi Freedom Shield
exercises.scale: approx. 18,000 Korean troops; about 70 personnel from 11 UNC states; 14 combined FTXs
exercises.summary: Summertime ROK-US combined exercise addressing drone, GPS-jamming and cyber threats and supporting preparation for wartime OPCON transition.

exercises.name: Freedom Edge
exercises.location: International waters east and south of Jeju Island, South Korea
participants: South Korea (ROKS Yulgok Yi I, ROKS Seoae Ryu Seong-ryong)
Japan (JS Atago, JS Asahi, P-1, SH-60K, F-15)
United States (USS Benfold, patrol aircraft, fighters, tankers)
exercises.scale: six Aegis-equipped destroyers plus patrol aircraft, fighters and tankers
exercises.summary: Third iteration of the US-Japan-ROK trilateral multi-domain exercise, aimed at countering North Korean nuclear and missile threats. End date derived from the source's "five-day" wording.
exercises.coord_basis: Sea area south/east of Jeju; end date derived from 'five-day' wording
